commandShortcutFiles.description: Paths or globs, relative to this file's folder, of files holding more command shortcuts. A .json file holds an array of shortcuts or an object with commandShortcuts; any other file holds one command per line, ignoring blank lines and lines starting with #.

commandShortcuts.description: Minecraft commands shown as shortcuts in the Minecraft Debugger home panel.

label.description: Text shown instead of the command.
